description: This file declares utility functions, structures, and classes for handling OpenSSL SSL/TLS operations, error mapping, and logging within the Chromium project. It includes functions for error handling, SSL configuration, and version retrieval, specifically tailored for OpenSSL integration.

classes.name: SslSetClearMask
classes.description: Utility struct for constructing SSL option and mode masks.

classes.name: OpenSSLErrorInfo
classes.description: Struct to store information about an OpenSSL error stack entry.

methods.name: OpenSSLPutNetError
methods.description: Logs a net error onto the OpenSSL error stack, including source location.

methods.name: MapOpenSSLError
methods.description: Converts an OpenSSL error code into a net error code, walking the error stack.

methods.name: MapOpenSSLErrorWithDetails
methods.description: Converts an OpenSSL error code into a net error code with detailed error info.

methods.name: NetLogOpenSSLError
methods.description: Logs an OpenSSL error to the NetLog.

methods.name: GetNetSSLVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the SSL version number for a given SSL connection.

methods.name: SetSSLChainAndKey
methods.description: Configures an SSL object with a certificate and key.
